mcps.name: Approvals
mcps.description: How the approvals a person asked for ended (an admin sees everyone's).

mcps.name: Atelier
mcps.description: The Atelier platform's configuration by conversation — Guardian rules, people & levels, initiative and daily brief, model tiers, workflows, platform status. Every write waits for the admin's Aprovar (Ask rule); every other role is blocked.

mcps.name: Cases
mcps.description: Solved problems as cases (Atelier Memory phase C) — search and read past cases, file a new one after a conversation that solved something.

mcps.name: Cinema
mcps.description: Modo Cinema and Cinema Party — per room, the lights (and blinds, other screens) follow the film on Plex: dim on play, 30 % on pause, back to before at the end; party follows the film's colours across one or several rooms. Status, mode, start and end a session.

mcps.name: Cloudflare
mcps.description: Cloudflare management — DNS records, tunnels, Zero Trust (users, devices, access groups, device profiles, WARP split tunnels, tunnel routes, local domain fallback, device settings), Gateway DNS/HTTP/network policies and lists, SSL/TLS, firewall rules, IP access rules, cache, and zone analytics via REST API

mcps.name: Duplicacy
mcps.description: Duplicacy backup monitoring — storage configs, schedules, backup status, backup history, job logs, and health checks via SSH + HTTP API

mcps.name: ElevenLabs
mcps.description: ElevenLabs Agents for Butler voice mode — voices and Voice Library, agents (authentication always required, overrides only for prompt/first message/language), client tools, conversations, usage; outbound calls only to an allowlist, admin-confirmed

mcps.name: FortiGate
mcps.description: FortiGate 60F firewall — policies, address objects, service objects, DHCP, static routes, VPN, bandwidth stats, system health, FortiSwitch management, and FortiAP/WiFi management via REST API

mcps.name: History
mcps.description: Questions over the home's events (90 days) — what happened in a window, and the last time something happened.

mcps.name: Homebridge
mcps.description: Homebridge smart home control — accessory listing, characteristic control, bridge management, plugin config, and system monitoring via REST API. Manages what Homebridge bridges into HomeKit; does not talk to Apple's HomeKit framework directly (renamed from 'homekit' 2026-08 for accuracy).

mcps.name: Household
mcps.description: Household settings, the same for the whole family — the streaming services the house subscribes to and the Siri alias. Read-only; the admin edits them in the Console (Pessoas → Família).

mcps.name: HPE iLO
mcps.description: HPE iLO 4 server management — system info, processors, memory, storage, network adapters, temperatures, fans, power supplies, power control, indicator LED, iLO management, event logs, firmware inventory, virtual media, and license info via Redfish REST API

mcps.name: Inbox
mcps.description: What happened, for the agents — recent notifications, incidents, approvals and jobs, one item in detail, mark read or acknowledged.

mcps.name: Incidents
mcps.description: Incidents with their alert, timeline and investigation finding.

mcps.name: NetBox
mcps.description: Atelier Butler MCP Server for NetBox — AI-native interface for IP address management, network prefixes, VLANs, devices, and infrastructure inventory

mcps.name: iperf3
mcps.description: iperf3 network diagnostics — bandwidth testing between hosts with configurable protocols, duration, and parallel streams via SSH + docker exec

mcps.name: Knowledge graph
mcps.description: The platform graph (containers, routes, agents, MCP servers, devices, jobs) — search, one entity, and what depends on what. Read-only.

mcps.name: Media
mcps.description: Unified media platform — Sonarr (TV series), Radarr (movies), SABnzbd (downloads), Plex (library browsing, search, metadata, playback sessions, playlists), and Overseerr (requests, approvals, user quotas) via REST APIs. Merged 2026-08 from the separate media-stack, plex, and overseerr servers.

mcps.name: Atelier Memory
mcps.description: The household's memory (ADR-0028) — search, read, remember, forget and export what Butler knows about a person.

mcps.name: Minecraft
mcps.description: Atelier Butler MCP Server for Minecraft Paper — AI-native interface for server management via RCON + SSH

mcps.name: NGINX Proxy Manager
mcps.description: NGINX Proxy Manager — reverse proxy hosts, SSL certificates, redirection hosts, streams, and health monitoring via REST API

mcps.name: Observability
mcps.description: Atelier Butler MCP Server for Prometheus — AI-native interface for infrastructure metrics, alerting, and time-series observability via PromQL

mcps.name: People
mcps.description: The People page as tools — list and explain people and their access; adding, removing and changing levels always waits for an approval.

mcps.name: Shelly
mcps.description: Shelly device management — energy monitoring, power metrics, switch control, remote reboot, temperature, WiFi status, and firmware updates via Gen2/Gen3 RPC API

mcps.name: Tautulli
mcps.description: Tautulli Plex monitoring — current activity, watch history, library stats, recently added, user analytics, and server health via REST API

mcps.name: Trail
mcps.description: Search the audit Trail — who called what, with which verdict and result.

mcps.name: Unimus
mcps.description: Unimus network config management — device inventory, config backups, diffs, change tracking, scheduled backups, and discovery via REST API

mcps.name: UNRAID
mcps.description: UNRAID server management — containers, VMs, shares, disks, temperatures, and system commands via SSH

mcps.name: Uptime Kuma
mcps.description: Uptime Kuma monitoring — monitors, heartbeats, uptime stats, status pages, Docker hosts, and Prometheus metrics via Socket.IO

mcps.name: Vaultwarden
mcps.description: Vaultwarden/Bitwarden secrets management — vault auth, item/folder CRUD, search, credential retrieval, TOTP, password generation with full client-side encryption (PBKDF2/Argon2, AES-CBC, HMAC-SHA256). Supports Vaultwarden 1.32+ camelCase API.

mcps.name: Weather
mcps.description: Weather from IPMA open data — daily forecast for a city (default Viana do Castelo) and active warnings for a district. Read-only, no key.

mcps.name: Guest WiFi
mcps.description: Guest WiFi admission — status, the arrivals switch, and admitting a guest with a temporary FortiGate user (after the host approves).

mcps.name: Workflows
mcps.description: Routines by conversation — a person's agent proposes a workflow, created disabled; it runs only after the admin approves it.
